title: Teamup
wikitext:
[[Teamup]] was supposed to be a [[4on4]] [[Team Deathmatch]] tournament.

* website: none
* IRC channel: [irc://port80.se.quakenet.org/teamup #teamup] ([[QuakeNet]])

== History ==
The league called [[Teamup]] was announced, the website was coded but not totally done, the admins were present, the maps were made but it never happened. This was supposed to be a league to promote custom maps in the stubborn European quakeworld scene. Sad enough the coder wasn't active enough to fix the bugs on the site and that pushed the starting date of the tournament forward months and months.
